notes.title: 1 year Anniversary update
notes.content:
Hi All!

It has been a year since we released Pocket Oasis! How time flies!

To celebrate the anniversary we have taken all your feedback and have updated the game. 

We added the function to remove pets.

This is what we improved and Fixed:
Improvements:
Enhanced plant focusing: Plants in front of the focused plant are now hidden for better visibility.
Improved plant focus behavior: Now considers plant height to keep more of the plant in frame.
Streamlined moving plants to and from the Greenhouse for a smoother experience.
Adjusted pest frequency for better game balance.
Upgraded tutorial bubble: Now features an X button to close and can be reopened via a notification on the side.

Fixes:
Resolved time tracker issue for switched-out balconies.
Fixed Greenhouse temperature modifier to apply correctly.
Corrected Umbrella decor sunlight modifier.
Fixed Paper Candle not displaying properly when flipped.
Trellis now correctly represented in the game.
Addressed visual issues with Ladybirds.
Corrected Lemon plant display inconsistencies.
Fixed harvesting issues with the Fennel plant.
Resolved flickering of plant fruits.
Fixed tracking issues when picking fruit.
Adjusted various plant stats for accuracy.
Corrected Japanese and Korean translations of plant names in the Almanac.
Enjoy the update and happy gardening! 🌿

notes.title: Quality of Life Improvements
notes.content:
This patch includes the following updates and bug fixes:

- Pest frequency and management improved
- Windowed mode added
- Fig unlock condition fixed
- Language selection persists between sessions
- Simplified Chinese language font and translation fixes

Thanks for playing Pocket Oasis!

we also fixed an issue with the pest system.

notes.title: Zurich Pop Con 2023 Recap and STEAM NEXT FEST IS NEXT!!!
notes.content:
We were so delighted to show Pocket Oasis at Zurich Pop Con last week!

With Pocket Oasis, we set out to design a game that would transport players to a tranquil haven, offering respite from the fast-paced nature of modern gaming. At the heart of our vision was the idea of having players cultivate their own virtual oasis, filled with lush plants and friendly wildlife. At Zurich Pop Con, we sought to channel this vision by setting up a tranquil, aesthetic booth filled with free plants for people to take home. We wanted to offer a little break from an otherwise packed and crazy convention and allow people to actually touch grass!

[img]https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdHR3cDdrNHMwdm54bXdkYm02ejB6azcwOW9vNWpkMGRnd3EycTkxOSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/bLgVPKNn1cvzcMYCJH/giphy.gif[/img]

Participating in the Zurich Pop Con was a dream come true for our team. It was a chance to connect with fellow developers, share our passion, and introduce Pocket Oasis to a wider audience. Plus, our first completed in-game enviro is set in Zurich! Seeing attendees immerse themselves in a familiar city was very rewarding and we got tons of incredible feedback and insights.

Up next, we’re taking Pocket Oasis to a more global stage.

Catch us from Monday, October 9 - Oct 16 when we bring Pocket Oasis to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/nextfest]STEAM NEXT FEST[/url]!

Save the date and see you there!

notes.title: 🌟 ZURICH POP CON 2023 + Gamescom Recap 🌟
notes.content:
[h3]🌟 Gamescom 2023 Recap: Pocket Oasis at the Swiss Pavilion 🇨🇭[/h3]

After an absolutely incredible time showcasing our game, Pocket Oasis, at Gamescom 2023, we’re back and ready to push Pocket Oasis ever closer to release.

First and foremost, a massive thank you to everyone who stopped by our booth and showed their love and support for Pocket Oasis. Your enthusiasm and feedback mean the world to us, and it was amazing to connect with gamers who share our passion for indie games. 🙌

Here are some of the highlights from our time at Gamescom:

1️⃣ The Swiss Pavilion: We were honored to be part of the Swiss Pavilion, alongside other talented indie developers from Switzerland. The sense of camaraderie among the developers was heartwarming and inspiring. 

2️⃣ Feedback: We had a blast demonstrating and pitching Pocket Oasis to such a wide, diverse audience. It was a wonderful opportunity to get some fresh perspectives on our game's potential. We received invaluable feedback that will help us refine the game even further.

4️⃣ Networking: Gamescom was not just about showcasing our game; it was also an opportunity to connect with fellow indie developers. The sense of community was palpable, and we had fantastic conversations, sharing experiences and learning from each other. The indie game community is so supportive, kind, and tight-knit - our studio name knit’n’purl is so appropriate! 

5️⃣ Swiss Gaming Excellence: The Swiss Pavilion was a testament to the quality and diversity of Swiss game development. It was fantastic to see our country's talent shine on the international stage, and we're proud to be part of such an innovative community.

In conclusion, Gamescom 2023 was an unforgettable experience for the knit’n’purl team. The connections we made, feedback received, and the overall energy of the event have fueled our determination to make Pocket Oasis the best it can be.

Thank you once again to everyone who joined us on this journey at Gamescom. Your support means everything to us, and we can't wait to share more updates about Pocket Oasis with you as we continue to develop and refine our game. Stay tuned for more exciting news!

[h3]🌟 Come find us at ZURICH POP CON!!! 🇨🇭[/h3]

Stop by and take a rest at our Oasis amid the chaos of [url=https://zurichpopcon.ch/en]Zurich Pop Con[/url]! We're delighted to be a part of it at the end of the month! Come garden with us 💜🌱

notes.title: 🎉 Game Release Date for Steam and Nintendo Switch! 🎮
notes.content:
Hey gardeners,

We're thrilled to share some updates about the upcoming release of Pocket Oasis on both Steam and Nintendo Switch: 

[h2][b]We will be releasing in Early 2024!!
[/b][/h2]

In the meantime, we’re excited to invite you to join [url=https://discord.gg/7ywRJU9FpF]our 🌱growing 🌱Discord server[/url]. Connect with fellow players, discuss the game’s development, share your experiences (and plants!), and stay up-to-date with the latest news directly from the developers:

[url=https://discord.gg/7ywRJU9FpF][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122835/a68e5c5ccb705e9ec61ce20785414b020e92b670.gif[/img][/url]

As we gear up for the big release, the development team is hard at work fine-tuning various aspects of the game. Here's a sneak peek into what we're focusing on:

🔧 [b]Refining the Game's Tutorial System:[/b] We understand the importance of a smooth learning curve. We're building out a tutorial system to provide you with an intuitive and engaging onboarding experience that will get you elbows deep in soil and fertilizer in no time!

🔓 [b]Fleshing Out Unlock Conditions:[/b] We’re enhancing the unlock conditions for various plants, pots, and decorative items, giving you more goals to strive for and rewards to unlock.

🏆 [b]Implementing Achievements:[/b] What good is a beautiful balcony garden if you can’t share it with anyone? We’re working on an achievement system so you can showcase your in-game accomplishments and milestones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44122835/c31210c057a6fab786b6ba1817d405d91e30554e.png[/img]
